description: Create a vendor. Name is required and must be unique within the tenant; code, tax number and bank account (when supplied) must be unique too. Set defaultLeadTimeDays (0-365) to give the reorder engine a fallback lead time. Pass customFields to set tenant-defined custom field values (see list_custom_fields with entity=businessPartner); an unknown fieldName fails the whole call at preview. The partner is created with the vendor role. Requires an operator (unpinned) org token. Returns the created vendor, whose id is what you attach per-item vendor terms to.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

bankAccountNumber.description: Optional bank account number; unique within the tenant when supplied.

code.description: Optional short code for the supplier; unique within the tenant when supplied.

customFields.description: Custom field values keyed by fieldName (see list_custom_fields, entity=businessPartner — vendors and customers share the businessPartner entity). list fields take an option id or name; multilist an array of them. An unknown fieldName fails validation.

defaultLeadTimeDays.description: Optional default lead time in days (0-365) — the reorder engine's fallback when no item-specific or historical lead time exists.

name.description: Supplier display name (required); must be unique within the tenant.

paymentTermsDays.description: Optional payment terms in days (0-365; 30 = "Net 30"). New purchase orders to this vendor carry them unless the order names its own.

taxNumber.description: Optional tax/registration number; unique within the tenant when supplied.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing is created until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.

title: Create Vendor
